seo.title: Privacy Policy
seo.description: AruRecord privacy policy: information about the contact form, analytics and data processing.

controller.heading: 1. Data Controller
controller.intro: The controller of personal data collected through this website is:

form.heading: 2. Contact Form
form.text: Data provided in the contact form (name, email address, message content) is processed solely to respond to your enquiry.

analytics.heading: 3. Analytics and Advertising (Google)

ga.label: Google Analytics:
ga.text: We use Google tools to collect anonymous traffic statistics (e.g. time spent on the site, browser type). This data helps us improve the website.

ads.label: Google Ads (AdSense):
ads.text: Ads may be displayed on the website. Google uses cookies (e.g. the DART cookie) to serve ads tailored to your interests based on your visits to this and other websites.

analytics.manage: You can manage your ad settings or opt out of personalization in your Google account settings.

recipients.heading: 4. Who receives the data?
recipients.intro: Your data may be shared with the following parties:

hosting.label: Hosting provider:
hosting.text: – to store data on the server.

authorities.label: Authorized public authorities:
authorities.text: Only if they request it on the basis of legal provisions.

rights.heading: 5. Your Rights
rights.text: You have the right to access your data, to rectify it, to erase it (the “right to be forgotten”), to restrict its processing, and to object to its processing.
